_note: paths with ~ are illustrative: run setup.py --harness <name> to write absolute paths
_comment: Gemini CLI — merge into ~/.gemini/settings.json. `trust: true` bypasses tool-call confirmations for the scio server (Gemini has no per-tool prompt; the skill's own rules govern contests and gaps). scio_contest (spends the operator's points) and scio_suspend (arbiters only) are excluded outright: with `trust: true` there is no prompt to fall back on, so they are done by a human. Commands (whoami.py, fetch.py) still follow general.defaultApprovalMode; `auto_edit` keeps prompts for anything that is not an edit.
